EVERYTHING else = iter-12 champion EXACTLY (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=2.16e-4, epochs=5, batch_size=1, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0) so this is a TRUE replicate of the reported champion config (n2400 held -- NOT trimmed). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-12 (c24/ep5/bs1/lr2.16e-4/seed42): 0.8638=CHAMPION, SSIM 0.9987, PSNR 53.64, RMSE 7.10e-4, elapsed 1190.98s=19.85min. iter-13 (bs1/ep4/lr1.5e-4): 0.8379 -- confirmed lr=2.16e-4/ep5 best at bs=1; TRAINING RECIPE FULLY MAPPED (lr optimal 2.16e-4, alpha_init inert, bs=1>>bs=2, epochs wall-capped, arch k=2/c=24 bounded). (2) FAILURE MODE: none -- search PLATEAUED at the champion. Remaining iters establish the champion SEED SPREAD (leaderboard mean+/-std, per the itnet_v2 sibling protocol). (3) ONE KNOB: seed 42 -> 43. (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr within ~+/-0.01 of 0.8638 at seed 43, giving the 2nd point of the champion mean+/-std and confirming robustness. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr swings >0.02 from 0.8638, the champion is seed-sensitive (val_n=200 noise floor) -> iters 15+ widen the replicate set. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): IDENTICAL config to iter-12 except the seed scalar (no compute change) -> elapsed ~= iter-12's 1190.98s=19.85min, just inside 1200s. max_train_s=1130 fences the TRAIN phase so if this node is slower than iter-12's the train loop truncates gracefully and a finite val+figure still land inside the 30-min sbatch wall (the metric is still computed on the trained-so-far model -> valid numeric-headroom obs). train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap; bs=1 low peak mem). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-14 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-15.
